exposure: Different classifications of PAS (Placenta Previa Accreta, Low Risk Placenta Previa, High Risk Placenta Previa, Placenta Accreta involving bladder injury)
outcome: Urinary tract injuries (bladder and ureteral injuries)
cohort: The study included 220 patients diagnosed with Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) at Rafik Hariri University Hospital in Beirut between 2007 and 2022.
finding: Managing Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) via cesarean hysterectomy poses a substantial risk of urinary tract injuries, with 32% of hysterectomy patients in this study experiencing such injuries.
mod_finding: Cesarean hysterectomy, as a surgical management for Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS), is associated with a significant risk of urinary tract injuries.
